title: Locomotive Half Marathon 2026 Review: Indonesia's Railway-Backed 21K in Lampung
seo_title: Locomotive Half Marathon 2026 Review | Bandar Lampung Indonesia
meta_description: The Locomotive Half Marathon 2026: September 20 in Bandar Lampung. 21K, 10K, 5K from PT Kereta Api Indonesia — one of the most unusual race organisers in Southeast Asia.
dek: Set for 20 September 2026 in Bandar Lampung, Sumatra, this half marathon is organised by PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Indonesian Railways) — possibly the most unusual race organiser in the region. Registration open.
verdict: The Locomotive Half Marathon has perhaps the most distinctive organiser in Southeast Asian road racing: PT Kereta Api Indonesia (KAI), the country's national railway company, partnering with RAW Organizer / Runaway Lampung. Three distances (21K, 10K, 5K) with registration open via TipTip. Bandar Lampung is Sumatra's southern gateway, a port city with views across the Sunda Strait to Java. The railway-branded concept gives this race genuine novelty — train-themed medals, anyone? For runners wanting an Indonesian half marathon with a story unlike anything else on the calendar, this is a standout.

sections.heading: PT KAI: The Railway Runs
paragraphs: PT Kereta Api Indonesia is the national railway company — a state-owned enterprise that operates Java and Sumatra's rail networks. Bandar Lampung is Sumatra's southernmost city, accessible by flight from Jakarta or ferry from Java across the Sunda Strait.
